items.evidence: Reservoir in slot 1 and plate in slot 2 are loaded with the required labels. The p20 (left) and p300 (right) are loaded with their matching tip racks in slots 10 and 11.
The log shows 12 cycles of aspirate 100 uL from reservoir A1 and dispense 100 uL into plate A1 through A12, all with the p300 and no other wells.
Each cycle picks up a tip before aspirating and drops it afterward, so the robot never pipettes without a tip and ends without one.
apiLevel 2.15 is within the allowed range, 100 uL is within the p300 range, and the blow_out above the destination well is safe.
The protocol does exactly the requested transfer, and its comments and metadata describe it accurately.

judge.summary: The protocol loads the specified labware with the right labels and transfers 100 uL from reservoir A1 to plate A1–A12 with the p300, using a fresh tip per well. All five rubric items pass.
